text:
alice: Heads up — perf regression in canary after yesterday's rollout, p95 token latency up ~35% for long contexts. CI perf flagged it.

ci-bot: [perf-check][FAIL] runtime/p90 increased 34% on gcp-us-central for workload 'longseq'. Details: https://ci/redwood/perf/9876

bob: saw that too. repro locally? I can run bench.

chen: I repro — batch size 8, seq 1024, p95 increased from 420ms -> 580ms. command I used: `./tools/bench --model=redwood/gpt-small --batch=auto --seq=1024`

dana: any recent commits touching kernel selection or KV cache?

mike: suspect commit 3f4c2a7 (kernel_selector: prefer fused-kernel for small batch) merged yesterday in main. PR #4621

alice: good call. CI shows kernel_selector.cc change. can someone git bisect? I don't have cycles.

bob: I ran bisect, culprit is 3f4c2a7 indeed. it switches policy for batch<16 causing fallback to slower fused path for long sequences. short explanation below:

```
commit 3f4c2a7
Author: Mike
diff --git a/.../kernel_selector.cc
- if (batch <= 16) use_fast_kernel = true;
+ if (batch < 16) use_fast_kernel = true; // oops off-by-one
```

chen: also noticed kv cache invalidation hits when sequence splits happen — might be interacting with fused kernel's KV stride. When cache invalidates more often, throughput drops.

dana: OK we need a hotfix. Plan: revert the off-by-one in main and cherry-pick to release/v1.8.2, run perf job, then canary rollout to dedicated pool.

release-bot: Created issue perf/9879 and triggered release branch candidate: release/v1.8.2-hotfix1

alice: I'll open revert PR against main and a backport PR to release/v1.8.2. PRs: #4680 revert, #4681 backport. mike can you review fast?

mike: on it. will also add a KV-cache regression test to guard the case.

ci-bot: PR #4680 build passed, perf job queued: https://ci/.../perf/9890

bob: once merged, we should run the full longseq perf suite and do a 10% canary on dedicated GPUs. steps I will run:
- merge -> k8s image build -> push -> `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:hotfix-v1.8.2` -> `kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime` -> run `./tools/bench --canary --rep=50`

chen: I'll validate kv cache metrics (redis/histograms) and p95 token latency after canary.

dana: timeline? need to coordinate with docs and CS for release note.

alice: target 2 hours: merge in 15m, canary in 45m, full rollout after perf signoff. tagging release v1.8.2-hotfix1.

mike: merged revert and backport, PR numbers merged: #4680, #4681. cherry-pick SHA abcdef1 applied to release branch.

ci-bot: perf job shows p95 back to baseline (430ms) on canary nodes. perf/9890: PASS

bob: canary looks good. promoting to 100% now.

release-bot: rollout completed. release artifact: s3://releases/redwood/v1.8.2-hotfix1/runtime-hotfix. Changelog: revert kernel-selector off-by-one + KV-cache test.

alice: great work all :tada: Leaving postmortem draft in #postmortems/ please add details.

chen: added short repro and bench logs.

dana: reminder: add unit test for kernel-selector edge case and a regression guard in perf CI.

alice: noted, will follow up.
